DASHBOARD._header: The agent marketplace of the data space
DASHBOARD._subheader: Discover and contract AI agents in the data space. Every agent publishes its skills, speaks A2A, is found through the ANP registry and is invoked only with a verifiable credential under its ODRL policy.
DASHBOARD._search_ph: Search agents by skill, provider or protocol...

landing._search_hint: Type to filter the categories below, or open the full list of agents and services.
landing._about_title: Agents you can trust, contracted like any other data space asset
landing._about_text: Providers publish their agents as TM Forum offerings: the agent card (skills and endpoint), the protocol and the access policy. Consumers contract them here and their own agents invoke them through the provider gateway, presenting a verifiable credential.
landing._benefit1_text: Each participant and each agent has a DID; access is granted with verifiable credentials (OID4VC) checked by the provider verifier.
landing._benefit2_text: Every agent carries its ODRL policy and credential requirements; the gateway enforces them on each call (APISIX + OPA).
landing._benefit3_text: Agents talk A2A, are discovered through ANP and reach data and tools with MCP over NGSI-LD, so they compose into multi-agent flows.
landing._provider_title: Publish your agents in the data space
landing._provider_text: Publish an agent card, set its ODRL policy and the credential its consumers must hold, and keep control of every invocation. If your organisation is not part of the data space yet, request access.

MAS._vc_required_hint: Requires a verifiable credential to invoke this agent
MAS._mesh_aria: Illustration of the agent network: an orchestrator exchanges A2A messages with the agents, discovers them through the ANP registry, checks verifiable credentials with the verifier and reaches data through MCP.
MAS._layers_text: Four layers make every agent of the marketplace interoperable and accountable: messaging, discovery, tools and trust.

a2a._text: Agents expose an agent card with their skills and receive tasks over JSON-RPC, with streaming and task tracking.

anp._text: A registry of agent descriptions bound to DIDs lets orchestrators find the right agent for each step of a flow.

mcp._text: Agents reach data and tools of the data space through MCP servers, read-only over NGSI-LD context brokers.

vc._text: Callers present a MachineCredential (OID4VC); the verifier checks it against the trusted issuers list and the gateway enforces the ODRL policy.
